title: System-wide hematopoietic and immune signaling aberrations in COVID-19 revealed by deep proteome and phosphoproteome analysis
authors: Kaneko T; Esmail S; Voss C; Martin CM; Slessarev M; Hovey O; Liu X; Ye M; Kim S; Fraser D; Li SS
one_liner_zh: 该文通过蛋白质组和磷酸化蛋白质组学分析COVID-19患者血液信号通路，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
SUMMARY

The COVID-19 pandemic, caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, has become a global crisis. To gain systems-level insights into its pathogenesis, we compared the blood proteome and phosphoproteome of ICU patients with or without SARS-CoV-2 infection, and healthy control subjects by quantitative mass spectrometry. We find that COVID-19 is marked with hyperactive T cell and B cell signaling, compromised innate immune response, and dysregulated inflammation, coagulation, metabolism, RNA splicing, transcription and translation pathways. SARS-CoV-2 infection causes global reprogramming of the kinome and kinase-substrate network, resulting in defective antiviral defense via the CK2-OPN-IL-12/IFN-α/β axis, lymphocyte cell death via aberrant JAK/STAT signaling, and inactivation of innate immune cells via inhibitory SIRPA, SIGLEC and SLAM family receptor signaling. Our work identifies CK2, SYK, JAK3, TYK2 and IL-12 as potential targets for immunomodulatory treatment of severe COVID-19 and provides a valuable approach and resource for deciphering the mechanism of pathogen-host interactions.
abstract_zh:
摘要

由SARS-CoV-2病毒引起的COVID-19大流行已成为全球性危机。为深入了解其发病机制的系统层面特征，我们通过定量质谱法比较了重症监护病房（ICU）患者中感染与未感染SARS-CoV-2者以及健康对照者的血液蛋白质组和磷酸化蛋白质组。我们发现，COVID-19的特征在于T细胞和B细胞信号传导过度活跃、先天免疫应答受损，以及炎症、凝血、代谢、RNA剪接、转录和翻译通路失调。SARS-CoV-2感染导致激酶组和激酶-底物网络的全局重编程，进而通过CK2-OPN-IL-12/IFN-α/β轴造成抗病毒防御缺陷，通过异常的JAK/STAT信号传导导致淋巴细胞死亡，并通过抑制性SIRPA、SIGLEC和SLAM家族受体信号传导使先天免疫细胞失活。我们的工作确定了CK2、SYK、JAK3、TYK2和IL-12作为重症COVID-19免疫调节治疗的潜在靶点，并为解析病原体-宿主相互作用的机制提供了有价值的方法和资源。
